description:
Fork of SPQR.Footsteps.2 with four additional footstep sound categories: sneak (20 samples), Socks (18), bootsfly (24), barefoot (11). All other behaviour is identical to the upstream v2.

Credits: Original Footsteps plugin by SPQR (https://www.patreon.com/SPQR_aeternum), licensed CC BY 4.0. Helper scripts: MacGruber (MacGruber_Utils), geesp0t and AcidBubbles (collision/trigger reference).

Load on a Person atom via Plugins tab → Add Plugin.
credits: SPQR (original plugin), MacGruber (MacGruber_Utils.cs), geesp0t (spanking plugin reference), AcidBubbles (collision groundwork)
instructions: Add to a Person atom via the Plugins tab → Add Plugin. Pick a sound surface from the 'Sounds' dropdown. Adjust Impact Min/Max and Cooldown to taste.
